user.title: UniFi Site Manager
user.description: Enter an API key created at unifi.ui.com (API section). It is stored only in Home Assistant.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate UniFi Site Manager
reauth_confirm.description: The API key was rejected. Enter a new key from unifi.ui.com.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the UniFi Site Manager API.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. See the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: UniFi Site Manager is already configured.

data.confirm_polls: Consecutive offline polls before a device counts as offline
data.outage_devices: Devices down at one site to raise a site outage
data.outage_minutes: Minutes those devices must have been down
data.device_entities: Create connectivity and firmware entities for every device
data.stale_update_days: Days a firmware update can be pending before it counts as overdue

data_description.ignore_prefixes: Case-insensitive. Matching consoles and devices are left out of every count and get no entities.
data_description.device_entities: Turn off to keep only consoles and the account-wide totals.
data_description.stale_update_days: Age is measured from when the integration first saw the update, so it starts counting after install.
